note: Raw counts for docs/analysis/2026-09-20-validation-45-seed43-analysis.md. This is a SECOND random 45 (seed 43, 15 per hop) drawn from the same ADR 0007 pinned 600, used to test whether the patterns in the frozen-anchor note replicate. The frozen 45 in configs/anchor_set_45.json are UNTOUCHED and remain the official anchor set (ADR 0033); the seed-43 ids live in runs/anchor/validation_45_seed43.json (gitignored) and are a validation sample only. Every detector below was run on BOTH id sets with ONE implementation, so `frozen45` here is a re-measurement for calibration, not a copy of the first note.

category_definitions.template_leak: a predicted step is a bare prompt-scaffold line (Task:/Answer:/Question:/Decomposition:/Note/Example/Explanation)
category_definitions.template_loop: >=3 predicted steps identical after replacing digit runs with N
category_definitions.duplicate_step: two predicted steps identical after lowercasing/punctuation stripping
category_definitions.orphan_step: the plan emits >=1 back-reference, and some non-final step is never referenced by any later step (a sub-question computed and then discarded)
category_definitions.ref_out_of_range: evaluator chain_validity < 1.0 with >=1 predicted reference (a #k that is forward or self)
category_definitions.no_refs_though_gold_chains: prediction emits no #k at all while gold does (evaluator chain_validity = 0.0 by the METRICS.md 2.1 repair)
category_definitions.bracketed_ref_syntax: a predicted step writes [#k] rather than #k
category_definitions.question_restatement: a predicted step reuses >=85% of its own tokens from the question and covers >=70% of the question's tokens
category_definitions.exemplar_entity_bleed: a capitalised entity in the prediction occurs in the few-shot block of that item's own prompt and not in the question
category_definitions.novel_entity: a capitalised entity in the prediction occurs neither in the question nor in the few-shot block
category_definitions.right_shape_wrong_words: same step count as gold, evaluator step_f1 == 0.0, rouge_l_f1 >= 0.5

entities.prompt_source_note: The anchor_<id>.txt prompt files exist only for the FROZEN 45, so the seed-43 items were joined to the every-Nth positional prompt logs by question text. exp-020/021/022/008 have all 600 positional prompts (CPU dry-run regenerations), giving 45/45 coverage. exp-023/024/025 were given their as_is twin's few-shot block: the exemplar SET is identical and only the order differs, verified same=45 diff=0 on the frozen 45 where both sides have a prompt. exp-008 and exp-026 log 'Few-shot source: none (k=0)' on every prompt file (645/645 and 165/165), so their few-shot block is empty by construction.

sampling_caveat_summary.metric: per-hop mean step_f1 of the 15 drawn items minus the other 185 items of that hop, per arm

limitations: 45 items has no power; every count is descriptive and no significance test is run here.
The soft step-F1 numbers are an unregistered scratch diagnostic with a hand-chosen stopword list and threshold, reported at two thresholds for that reason.
The category detectors are heuristics, hand-checked on the cases they fire on and not swept for cases they miss, so every count is a lower bound.
Step alignment is greedy token-overlap at 0.34, a pointer to which gold step went missing, not a semantic judgement.
exp-027 and exp-028 (Qwen3.5-9B) are not on this sheet; exp-028 had not finished when it was rendered.
